question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
sql:
WITH top_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_per_order
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as num_orders,
    AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_per_order,
    MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as earliest,
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as latest,
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) < 7 THEN 1.0
        ELSE (CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE)) / 7
    END as lifespan_weeks
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top_customers)
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC

WITH customer_avg_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_per_order,
        COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
top_3_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        avg_payment_per_order,
        order_count
    FROM customer_avg_payment
    ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) as earliest_purchase,
        MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) as latest_purchase
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IN (

    )
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
final_result AS (

            THEN 1.0 
            ELSE (julianday(l.latest_purchase) - julianday(l.earliest_purchase)) / 7

    FROM top_3_customers t
    JOIN customer_lifespan l ON t.customer_id = l.customer_id
)
